titulo: Six seconds to flip the record
caption:
Six seconds to flip the record

The record ends and the room goes quiet. Turning it over takes six seconds, and there is a whole other side.

The silence after side one is the moment most evenings quietly change, and a flip keeps the music in the room.

For whoever flips the record instead of letting the music end.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a big black record standing on the floor at the right, an orange label in its middle. A ink-black block figure with white eyes trembles with narrowed eyes, then its eyes go wide, it walks closer and the record hops up and lands again with a blue label instead. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: side one ended. that's it., to: flipped it. side two.
